bio: Run by Stefan Pumm and his charming wife Anja, this restaurant serves delicious regional fare made from the freshest ingredients. Alongside the set menus, there is a well-curated à la carte selection. Highlights include house-made potato gnocchi with green asparagus, and Spessart beef shoulder braised in red wine. A perennial favourite: Chateaubriand with Béarnaise sauce, served for two. Dine in the elegant wood-panelled dining room or out on the lovely terrace. Well-appointed guestrooms....
